issues.title: Fix a typo in the README
issues.description: The README says "servce" in the line about `GET /health`. The right word is "service".

issues.title: Check the content type on POST /notes
issues.description: `POST /notes` accepts any body that parses as JSON. It should answer 415 when the Content-Type is not `application/json`.

issues.title: Limit the number of notes
issues.description: The service keeps all notes in memory with no limit. Add a maximum and answer 429 when the list is full.

merge_request.commit_message: feat(notes): limit the number of notes
merge_request.title: feat(notes): limit the number of notes
merge_request.description:
Keep at most 100 notes in memory. `POST /notes` answers 429 when the list is full. A test covers the limit.

Closes the issue "Limit the number of notes".
